full_judgment: 5. It is further stated that the petitioner is a service holder and, as such, it is not possible for him to manage the property as contained in the will and furthermore, Shishubala Roy resides upon the land as contained in the will and in this view of the matter, the petitioner gave a general power of attorney in favour of Shishubala Roy vide registered Khas Moktarnama executed and registered by petitioner appellant on 23-9-1982. As per that khas Moktarnama, this petitioner has conferred Shishubala Roy all powers including powers of conducting all legal proceedings regarding the property contained in the will. As such, the petition for revocation is filed by him by his lawful constituted attorney, Shishubala Roy. It is further stated that the probate being obtained from the Court by exercising fraud upon the Court, the petitioner has suffered irreparable loss for which he prays for revocation of granting of probate in respect of the will.
